task_completions:
The last time the U.S. federal government had a budget surplus was in **Fiscal Year 2000**.

Here's a bit more detail:

*   **FY 2000:** Surplus of $236.9 billion
*   There were also surpluses in FY 1999 ($122.7 billion) and FY 1998 ($69.2 billion).

Since then, the U.S. has consistently run budget deficits. While there have been efforts to reduce the deficit, it hasn't returned to a surplus since the turn of the millennium.



You can find more information from these sources:

*   **Congressional Budget Office (CBO):** [https://www.cbo.gov/topics/budget](https://www.cbo.gov/topics/budget)
